reason: E1 and E2 show a 40-fold coercivity increase in FeCoNiMnCu after RTA, attributed to microstructural changes and strain-induced anisotropy, not L1₀ ordering. L1₀ ordering is only reported with Pt addition, and the hypothesis incorrectly claims RTA alone induces L1₀ ordering in the Pt-free film, misrepresenting the cited evidence.
premises: RTA of FeCoNiMnCu films increases coercivity ~40-fold
The coercivity increase is due to microstructural changes and strain-induced anisotropy enhancing domain wall pinning
L1₀ ordering in FeCoNiMnCu films can be induced by RTA without Pt
Enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy increases domain wall pinning and coercivity
